payload.text: hv, 2026-10-27, directly to vc in vc's session, on the count rule, answering vc's question on 0113's 11,008 hits: "This is _BONKERS_. All I said was don't write guards or tests that compare against arbitrary magic numbers. HOW THE HELL HAS THIS TURNED INTO SOMETHING BIGGER THAN BEN HUR?!" and "This should simply be a sweep to get rid of magic numbers in tests and a rule not to add any into the future. The end. What is going on?!" vc's reading: the sweep is 0117 (the dispatch suites) and 0119 cut to the tests and guards outside them that compare against a written count (body set at 0bb4fce6); 0113 (prose, comments, test names) withdrawn (closed at 66cc534a); strings, comments, test input and test names are out. The rule for the future is hv's global AGENTS.md line, which hv OK'd narrowed in molt-vc's session (Molt-matts da71308): "No magic numbers in tests or guards ... Prose, comments, docs and names are outside this rule." Utilz writes no copy. The over-reach was vc's: decision 66 scoped from the old wording without asking hv what it was for, and vc did not stop it as it grew.
